headline: Indian Banking Gross NPA dropped from peak 8.84% (FY18) to 1.67% (FY25) for ICICI Bank
detailed_finding: Driven by RBI Asset Quality Review (AQR), strict recognition norms, and aggressive provisioning, ICICI Bank transformed its balance sheet from corporate asset stress in FY16-FY18 to a pristine retail-dominated franchise with credit cost dropping from 3.54% to 0.35%.

headline: HDFC Bank advances expanded 7.5x from INR 3.65 lakh Cr to INR 27.50 lakh Cr over FY15-FY25
detailed_finding: Propelled by organic market share gains and the landmark merger with parent HDFC Limited in July 2023, HDFC Bank emerged as the undisputed private sector leader, though requiring temporary margin stabilization as high-cost wholesale liabilities mature.

headline: Private sector banks elevated Provision Coverage Ratios (PCR) permanently above 75-80%
detailed_finding: Banks systematically shifted from unhedged provisioning in FY15-FY17 to conservative coverage buffers. ICICI Bank increased PCR from 40.2% (FY17) to 82.8% (FY23), ensuring Net NPA ratios remained under 0.50% despite subsequent macro cycles.

headline: Bajaj Finance maintained industry-best Gross Stage 3 below 1.0% while growing AUM 12.8x
detailed_finding: Despite surviving the 2018 IL&FS liquidity crisis and COVID-19 retail disruptions, Bajaj Finance leveraged omnichannel digital underwriting to expand AUM from INR 32,410 Cr (FY15) to INR 415,000 Cr (FY25) while keeping credit cost contained below 1.86%.

headline: Bureau Score and FOIR achieve 0.8597 ROC-AUC and 71.95% Gini in Default Discrimination
detailed_finding: Empirical logistic regression modeling on the 5,000 personal loan book confirms that debt obligation ratio (FOIR) and Bureau Score provide robust rank-ordering of default probability. Borrowers with FOIR > 50% and bureau score < 650 exhibit default probabilities exceeding 18.5%.

headline: 36-Month Cumulative Recovery caps at 32.82%, resulting in 67.18% LGD (69.52% Discounted LGD)
detailed_finding: Vintage tracking across 961 defaulted accounts reveals that over 80% of total lifetime recoveries occur within the first 12 months post-default (peaking at Month 2 with 5.1% monthly recovery). Beyond Month 24, marginal recovery drops below 0.1% per month, confirming steep economic depreciation.

theme: Unexpected Loss & Basel IRB vs Standardized Capital
headline: Standardized Approach capital (11.5% on 125% RWA) holds an INR 40.5 Cr capital buffer over IRB at rho=10%
detailed_finding: Under the Vasicek asymptotic single risk factor model at 99.9% confidence, unexpected loss capital scales from INR 42.1 Cr (rho=0.03) to INR 141.2 Cr (rho=0.16). Standardized approach imposes a conservative flat requirement, ensuring resilience against correlated portfolio shocks.

headline: 1-Day 99% VaR passed Kupiec test across all institutions, remaining securely in Basel Green Zone
core_metric: Kupiec POF LR Test Statistic & Zone
change_magnitude: Exception rate tightly bounded between 0.8% and 1.3%
detailed_finding: Out-of-sample backtesting over 1,240 trading days (2020-2025) confirms model robustness. Bajaj Finance exhibited the highest 1-day 99% VaR (4.85%) and Expected Shortfall (6.22%), reflecting high beta and growth-stock volatility, while HDFC Bank exhibited the lowest VaR (2.85%).

headline: RBI Unsecured Risk Weight Hike (Nov 2023) generated -3.42% CAR[-1, +1] on Bajaj Finance
detailed_finding: The equity market instantaneously penalized high-growth unsecured lenders following the 25% risk weight hike. Conversely, Kotak Mahindra Bank experienced a massive -10.85% announcement-day abnormal return following the April 2024 IT supervisory embargo.

headline: Systematic risk proportion surged from 38% in calm periods to over 68% during COVID-19 crisis
detailed_finding: During macroeconomic crises, institutional stock movements are dominated by macroeconomic beta and systemic liquidity contraction. In calm periods, idiosyncratic firm-specific underwriting quality, recovery execution, and management governance drive 60%+ of return variance.
